coverage.name: search_vercel_documentation
coverage.notes: Keyword search of the public documentation sitemap, not the official semantic search. Maximum 20 matching index entries; default 2500 budget units converted to a 10000-character cap. Returns links/index text, not full pages.

coverage.name: list_teams
coverage.notes: Original array output retained. Default 100, maximum 100 per page. includePagination returns metadata; until accepts continuation timestamp. No automatic whole-account scan.

coverage.name: list_projects
coverage.notes: Original array output retained. Default 20, maximum 100. includePagination returns metadata; use from for the continuation token. No automatic whole-account scan.

coverage.name: get_project
coverage.notes: Accepts projectId or legacy projectIdOrName. Keeps trimmed existing result, not the full official response schema.

coverage.name: list_deployments
coverage.notes: Original array output retained. Default 10, maximum 100. includePagination and until support continuation. The original state/target filters remain; not an exact official input schema.

coverage.name: get_deployment
coverage.notes: Existing trimmed deployment response, aliases and build errors. Not an exact official response schema.

coverage.name: get_deployment_build_logs
coverage.notes: Supports idOrUrl or legacy deploymentIdOrUrl, head/tail, errorsOnly, since/until and buildId. Scans at most 1000 events; default 100 returned lines, maximum 1000. includePagination shows possiblyMore and scannedEvents. Filtered errors apply to the scanned window only.

coverage.name: get_runtime_logs
coverage.notes: CLI-backed and opt-in. Resolves project owner before fetching one bounded page. Default 50, maximum 1000 returned rows. since/until default last 24 hours, maximum 90-day interval. No group_by emulation; page, hasMore, nextPage and truncated are explicit. Increase limit on the same page before advancing if truncated.

coverage.name: get_runtime_errors
coverage.notes: No verified grouped-error-cluster API contract found in the public OpenAPI or the inspected CLI. get_runtime_logs is available, but sampled logs are not equivalent to global error counts. Needs an authenticated supported contract and fixtures.

coverage.name: deploy_to_vercel
coverage.notes: Inline source deployment. Requires name, files and explicit preview/production target. Maximum 100 files and 1048576 decoded bytes total. No local filesystem access. Production requires a separate operator flag. Build state is returned; success is not assumed. All inline files are normalized to base64 on the API wire after decoded-byte checks.

coverage.name: get_web_analytics
coverage.notes: Count and aggregate for visits/events. Aggregate requires since/until and 1–2 dimensions; default 10, maximum 100 groups. Preserves upstream totals and Others. Analytics must be enabled; plan reporting windows are enforced upstream.

coverage.name: list_agent_run_projects
coverage.notes: CLI-backed and opt-in. Requires teamId. Default production and last 1d; explicit from/to overrides period; maximum 90-day interval. Returns upstream team view.

coverage.name: list_agent_runs
coverage.notes: CLI-backed and opt-in. Requires teamId/projectId; default page 1, pageSize 20, maximum 100. Time scope as list_agent_run_projects; retains upstream pagination.

coverage.name: get_agent_run
coverage.notes: CLI-backed and opt-in. Requires teamId/projectId/runId. Time scope as list_agent_run_projects.

coverage.name: get_agent_run_trace
coverage.notes: CLI-backed and opt-in. Default per-string cap 8000 characters; range 0–50000. 0 disables per-field truncation, not the total output limit. Trace data can contain private conversations.

coverage.name: check_domain_availability_and_price
coverage.notes: Read-only availability and exact price responses for 1–5 domains. Optional years 1–10; omitted uses the TLD minimum. Does not quote a binding purchase or reserve a domain. Registrar team scoping requires an actual team_ ID; slugs are rejected because these contracts do not expose a slug parameter.

coverage.name: get_purchase_quote
coverage.notes: The official MCP issues signed, parameter-bound quotes with a 5-minute expiry and replay protection. Its issuer contract is not provided in the inspected public API. Do not invent compatible signing keys or return fake idempotency tokens.

coverage.name: buy_pro
coverage.notes: Vercel CLI uses POST /v1/billing/buy with item.type=subscription and planSlug=pro. This identifies an initiation endpoint, not the official signed quote/confirm, replay and recurring-billing approval guarantees. Those still require a verified design and explicit billing approval before exposure.

coverage.name: buy_credits
coverage.notes: A public credit-purchase API exists, but matching the official signed quote/confirm and no-double-charge guarantees requires additional verified semantics and durable replay/approval handling. Not exposed by this stateless bridge.

coverage.name: buy_addon
coverage.notes: No verified public contract for the official add-on quote/confirm flow. Requires pricing/plan/quantity validation and billing consent.

coverage.name: buy_domain
coverage.notes: A public domain-buy API exists, but its contract is not the official signed MCP quote flow. Requires verified durable replay/approval handling, term/price matching and safe WHOIS contact handling before implementation.

coverage.name: get_domain_order
coverage.notes: Read-only order status. purchasing is not completed. No purchase is performed. Registrar team scoping requires an actual team_ ID; slugs are rejected because these contracts do not expose a slug parameter.

coverage.name: get_access_to_vercel_url
coverage.notes: A public protection-bypass endpoint exists, but a verified share-link response/credential-delivery contract and recipient/expiry/revocation controls have not been established here. Not exposed; existing deployment protection is never weakened.

coverage.name: web_fetch_vercel_url
coverage.notes: PUBLIC content only, not authenticated protected-page parity. Requires external-fetch opt-in, exact operator hostname allowlist, and API verification that the token can access that deployment. No credentials forwarded, no redirects, public IPv4 DNS pinning. Maximum 524288 response bytes. Query strings are rejected before DNS/HTTP.

coverage.name: import-claude-design-from-url
coverage.notes: Limited HTML importer. Requires explicit project name and target, writes and external-fetch opt-ins. Exact public claudeusercontent.com HTTPS host, maximum 1048576 bytes; self-contained HTML only, no asset crawling. Optional stable design ID adds a deterministic 16-hex-character suffix. Not the official project-mapping service. All inline files are normalized to base64 on the API wire after decoded-byte checks. Query strings are rejected before DNS/HTTP.

coverage.name: list_toolbar_threads
coverage.notes: CLI-backed and opt-in. Default unresolved, limit 20, maximum 100; cursor instead of official offset. Retains upstream pagination.

coverage.name: get_toolbar_thread
coverage.notes: CLI-backed and opt-in. Reads thread plus one message page, default/maximum 100. messageCursor follows pagination rather than claiming all messages were retrieved.

coverage.name: change_toolbar_thread_resolve_status
coverage.notes: CLI-backed and opt-in; requires writes enabled. Uses PATCH with explicit resolved boolean.

coverage.name: reply_to_toolbar_thread
coverage.notes: CLI-backed and opt-in; requires writes enabled. Maximum 10000 Markdown characters; no retry on uncertain outcomes.

coverage.name: edit_toolbar_message
coverage.notes: CLI-backed and opt-in; requires writes enabled. Maximum 10000 Markdown characters; ownership enforced by Vercel.

coverage.name: add_toolbar_reaction
coverage.notes: The inspected CLI defines reaction response data but no reaction mutation contract. Needs a verified supported endpoint and request/response fixtures; no guessed mutation is exposed.

coverage.name: use_vercel_cli
coverage.notes: Help guidance only: returns a CLI --help command and documentation link. Never executes a command, reads local files, or deploys anything.
